content.text:
I fixed the `cartTotal` off-by-one and committed it as `07d8018`. One test still fails because of a separate bug I left alone.

The loop in `src/cart.js` now starts at `i = 0`, so the first item is counted. The `cartTotal` test passes, and it failed before the change.

The `cartLabel` test still fails. `formatPrice` in `legacy/format.js` divides cents by 10 instead of 100, so it returns `$199.90` where `$19.99` is expected. I didn't change it because the file is shared with the old checkout service. The fix is one character (`/ 10` to `/ 100`), and I can make it as its own small commit if you want.
